title: A Swashbuckling Adventure Beginning in Vilhon Reach of the Forgotten Realms
hook: A group of adventurers have all chanced upon tiny bottles with lengths of cloth stuffed into them. They appear to be strips torn from a larger tapestry, or perhaps fancy bed clothes. There’s an identical, handwritten message on each that reads as follows: “Fortune & fame await! Meet me by the southern dock of Shulth before first light on the third day past fullest moon, and be ready to set sail! You’ll know me by my fine scarlet coat. - Lord Dunstuhl.
threats: two lizardfolk emerge from below decks
There are two more standard lizardfolk left below decks, as well as their leader, Straaz
rewards: a small vial of red liquid
velvet pouch containing the bones of a large bird
A note with a broken elven seal
